description: Single-panel schematic, labelled (a) in the caption as the "Phase transition temperature measurement process". It is a temperature–time (T–t) schedule drawn as a plain black polyline on unlabelled axes: the vertical axis is annotated "Temperature" with an upward arrow, the horizontal axis "Time" with a rightward arrow; there are no numeric ticks, gridlines or units on either axis. From the origin the curve rises steeply (near vertical) along a segment annotated "10 °C/s" to "200 °C", indicated by a small kink in the polyline. From 200 °C the line continues as a long shallow straight ramp annotated "0.01 °C/s", ending at "980 °C, 300 s" near the top right. A vertical segment at that point represents an isothermal hold of 300 s at 980 °C, and a steep downward segment on the right side, annotated "−30 °C/s", returns to the time axis. No measured data points, error bars, micrographs or spectra are present; all numbers printed are processing parameters of the thermal cycle (heating rate, intermediate temperature, maximum temperature, hold time, cooling rate), not measured quantities.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a temperature–time schematic whose vertical axis is annotated 'Temperature' with an upward arrow and whose horizontal axis is annotated 'Time' with a rightward arrow; neither axis carries numeric ticks or units.
The initial heating segment is annotated '10 °C/s' and terminates at a kink labelled '200 °C'.
Above 200 °C the profile continues as a long shallow ramp annotated '0.01 °C/s', i.e. a much slower heating rate than the initial segment.
The ramp ends at a point annotated '980 °C, 300 s' near the top right of the panel, followed by a vertical segment representing an isothermal hold.
A steep downward segment on the right is annotated '−30 °C/s', indicating the cooling rate returning to the time axis.
The figure contains only a schematic polyline: no measured data points, error bars, scale bars, legends, micrographs or spectra are present.
The caption identifies panel (a) as the 'Phase transition temperature measurement process'.
The values printed in the figure (10 °C/s, 200 °C, 0.01 °C/s, 980 °C, 300 s, −30 °C/s) are prescribed thermal-cycle parameters, not measured results.

subfigures.description: Temperature–time schematic of a thermal cycle: axes annotated Temperature (up arrow) and Time (right arrow) with no numeric ticks. Heating at 10 °C/s to 200 °C, then a slow ramp at 0.01 °C/s to 980 °C, an isothermal hold of 300 s at 980 °C, and cooling at −30 °C/s back to the time axis.
